items.evidence: Notes: "Agnes presented the wooden, customizable remote". Transcript shows the User Interface Designer is Agnes (she says "Christine can just correct me", so Christine is the Industrial Designer).
Notes: "A flip-panel LCD is included provisionally" and "The back and flip case could have customized designs."

Notes give the cost display ("€9.95 against a €12.50 budget", "adding it could cost about €2–€3 per remote") but state no conclusion about whether the LCD fits. Transcript differs from the key: Marketing says with the LCD it comes to "twelve, twelve and a half" and the Industrial Designer concludes "So that means we can put the LCD in", so the group did not decide the budget rules it out; the notes also do not state that conclusion.

Notes action item: "Negotiate lower production costs with vendors and discuss cost reductions with management". Transcript at 10:54 has the PM say the savings would go to marketing/promotions rather than to the display specifically, so the notes match the transcript.

Notes carry the substance ("Selling two million units in year one would require 25% of the market", "production cost could not exceed €25 to leave €25 profit per unit", "the company's sales and profit goals put feasibility in doubt") but never say the Marketing Expert presented this; the market figures are given without a speaker.
Notes: "Christine proposed online ordering and direct shipment as an alternative sales channel", "The group suggested Amazon or eBay".

Notes: "Agnes said the project had no redesign time if users found problems" and "The company representative chose to keep the basic design for market introduction and use customer feedback for a second generation."
Notes: "Christine suggested coordinating a user-tested launch with a major sports event" and "Christine suggested exploring a campaign with Sony Pictures around a DVD release."

Notes action item: "Negotiate lower production costs with vendors and discuss cost reductions with management (owner: Speaker 1)". The task is right but the owner is labeled "Speaker 1", a label used nowhere else in the notes (the PM is otherwise called "the company representative"), so the owner cannot be identified from the notes.

Notes: "The company representative said they would try to convince management" under the Sony Pictures item, plus action item "Try to convince management to pursue a campaign with Sony Pictures". Transcript 21:48: PM "I will convince the management to do that".
Nothing in the notes about Ed/the Marketing Expert taking over after production (transcript 23:16: "let's leave it to the Ed for later for once production is over").

Notes: "The company representative expected the production evaluation in two weeks, with the process taking up to four weeks", "Prototypes would be made outside the company's factory", "Production would begin after approval".

Notes say "The microphone location was unresolved" and only that "The group considered the side as an accessible placement"; transcript has the PM, Marketing Expert and UI Designer all agree the side is a good idea (05:52 to 06:16). LCD inclusion is stated only as "included provisionally"; the notes do not record the Industrial Designer's conclusion "we can put the LCD in".

Same as S4: action item "Negotiate lower production costs with vendors and discuss cost reductions with management". Per transcript the PM's stated aim was to free money for marketing, not the display, so the notes match the transcript.
Notes: sports-event launch and Sony Pictures DVD campaign suggested, and "The company representative said they would try to convince management."
Notes: "The company representative chose to keep the basic design for market introduction and use customer feedback for a second generation."

Notes: "The company representative expected the production evaluation in two weeks, with the process taking up to four weeks" and production starting after approval. Transcript 16:29: PM "let's wait for the production, okay, then uh you can evaluate the product".

Notes capture the profit concern ("The group questioned whether the company could reach its two-million-unit and €50 million profit targets") but say nothing about changing budget plans. Transcript also shows the budget side differently from the key: with the LCD the cost lands at the €12.50 budget and the group says the LCD can go in.

Notes: "the others argued for user testing and enough time to respond", "Agnes said the project had no redesign time if users found problems", "Agnes warned that insufficient testing could cause the first generation to fail."

errors.claim: Christine estimated the case could cost €1 for material and labor.
errors.why_wrong: The €1 case figure was on the Project Manager's cost sheet; the Industrial Designer only read it back with surprise ("you got some pretty cheap labour that can do this case for one Euro"). She did not make the estimate.

By 06:16 the Project Manager ("the sides maybe is good. So That's good idea"), the Marketing Expert and the UI Designer had all agreed on placing the microphone on the side; the notes present it as still open.
